message.content:
**Band 1 (Hero & Intro)**
(1) **Sections:** Hero banner with headline ("PRECISION COOLING, ENGINEERED"), navigation bar, and the "ABOUT CELSIUS" introductory text block.  
(2) **Logo:** Yes, the Celsius logo with the white wind icon and wordmark is clearly visible in the top center of the header.  
(3) **Issues:** No major visual issues; the layout is clean, text is well-spaced, and the background image renders correctly without overlapping the legible typography.  
(4) **Polish:** 9/10 — Professional, high-contrast design with strong typographic hierarchy.

**Band 2 (Suppliers & Services)**
(1) **Sections:** "AUTHORISED SUPPLIER OF" carousel area (currently showing navigation arrows/dots but missing images) and the "WHAT WE DO" section header.  
(2) **Logo:** Not visible in this specific vertical slice.  
(3) **Issues:** The supplier logo grid appears to be empty or failed to load, leaving a large blank white space; otherwise, the layout structure is intact.  
(4) **Polish:** 5/10 — Clean spacing is undermined by the missing content in the partner/supplier section.

**Band 3 (Solutions & Stats)**
(1) **Sections:** "SECTOR SOLUTIONS" intro text, a large light-gray placeholder area (likely for icons or graphics), and the dark blue "BY THE NUMBERS" container at the bottom.  
(2) **Logo:** Not visible.  
(3) **Issues:** The middle section feels excessively empty, suggesting missing graphical elements or a loading failure for the sector-specific imagery.  
(4) **Polish:** 6/10 — Typography is consistent, but the lack of visual content makes the band look incomplete.

**Band 4 (Profile & CTA)**
(1) **Sections:** "CEO PROFILE" (showing only the "Professional Journey" sub-header), "CASE STUDIES" intro text, "START YOUR PROJECT" call-to-action button, and the "WHAT CLIENTS SAY" header.  
(3) **Issues:** The CEO profile section appears to be missing the main image or biography content, resulting in awkward whitespace above the sub-header.  
(4) **Polish:** 6/10 — The CTA button is styled correctly, but the missing profile content disrupts the flow.

**Band 5 (Footer)**
(1) **Sections:** "TRUSTED BY" text block, "GET IN TOUCH" area (empty), and the main footer containing the Celsius logo, contact details, service links, and copyright info.  
(2) **Logo:** Yes, the full white Celsius logo is properly displayed in the footer column.  
(3) **Issues:** The "GET IN TOUCH" section is largely empty space before the footer begins; the footer itself is well-structured with clear columns.  
(4) **Polish:** 8/10 — Footer is professional and informative, though the preceding empty contact section slightly lowers the score.
